projects.title: Vaultline
projects.summary: A knowledge base that can show its sources — and knows when to stay quiet.
projects.problem: Retrieval can expose information a user should never have seen. An answer also needs evidence, not just confidence.
projects.approach: Apply document access rules before hybrid retrieval, then return exact cited passages or abstain. Keep lifecycle changes and answer feedback auditable.

projects.title: Multi-Task PPO Lab
projects.summary: One neural network learns two different jobs, and you can watch it play.
projects.problem: Reinforcement-learning demos often hide whether the agent learned anything: there is no baseline, no held-out test, and no way to watch it act.
projects.approach: Implement PPO with GAE from scratch in PyTorch, train one shared network with task-specific heads on navigation and key-and-door gridworlds, and score it on unseen layouts against random and optimal (breadth-first search) play.
highlights: PPO, GAE, and clipping written from scratch
Shared trunk with per-task policy and value heads
Held-out evaluation against random and optimal baselines

projects.title: Orbit
projects.summary: Catch a changing dataset before it becomes a broken decision.
projects.problem: Missing values, duplicates, and schema changes can quietly undermine downstream analytics.
projects.approach: Profile actual sample data, compare it with a baseline, evaluate quality rules, and turn repeated failures into deduplicated incidents.

projects.title: Delivery Desk
projects.summary: A focused delivery board with a history behind every change.
projects.problem: A shared task board needs more than colored cards: changes must persist and stale edits must not overwrite someone else's work.
projects.approach: Store tasks and their activity in SQLite, validate state changes on the server, and use version checks to reject conflicting edits.

projects.title: Stockroom
projects.summary: Every item accounted for. Every stock movement explained.
projects.problem: An inventory count is only trustworthy when receiving and dispatching stock cannot create impossible balances.
projects.approach: Record stock movements transactionally, reject dispatches beyond available stock, and make replenishment needs visible in a searchable ledger.

projects.title: Tracework
projects.summary: Turn stakeholder evidence into reviewable requirements and approved work.
projects.problem: Requirements lose context when stakeholder documents become disconnected tickets.
projects.approach: Ingest evidence, generate six source-cited artifact types, and require explicit review before local export.

projects.title: Inference Gateway
projects.summary: Inspect routing, quotas, and provider failures from one console.
projects.problem: A model API needs accountable routing and failure handling, especially when providers become unavailable.
projects.approach: Route compatible API requests through provider adapters, record each attempt, and manage keys, quotas, and prompt versions.
highlights: API keys, quotas, and prompt versions

projects.title: Sourcewell
projects.summary: Find extraction failures, replay a repair, and approve the change.
projects.problem: A small source-page change can silently corrupt a data pipeline.
projects.approach: Extract bounded fixture data, validate and quarantine records, detect DOM drift, and replay repair proposals before activation.

projects.title: Riskstream
projects.summary: Follow a suspicious event from its signals to an analyst decision.
projects.problem: A risk score is hard to act on without the contributing events and a consistent review workflow.
projects.approach: Compute event-time features, track late and duplicate events, explain rule-based scores, and export reviewed feedback.

projects.title: FlowLens
projects.summary: Turn an event log into a map of bottlenecks and repeat work.
projects.problem: Business processes are difficult to improve when their delays are hidden across individual records.
projects.approach: Import event logs and calculate process variants, transitions, wait times, SLA breaches, and grounded automation opportunities.
highlights: JSON, CSV, and safe XML import

projects.title: Quant Research Lab
projects.summary: Test a market idea against a random walk before trusting it.
projects.problem: Price forecasts and trading signals often look impressive only because the backtest leaked future data or ignored costs.
projects.approach: Build point-in-time features, score models walk-forward against a random walk with Diebold-Mariano tests, backtest a signal with next-bar entry and costs, and measure tail risk with VaR and GARCH.
highlights: Cost-aware signal backtest vs buy and hold
VaR, expected shortfall, GARCH, and Hurst
projects.mode: Bundled AAPL and BTC data · CSV upload

projects.title: OpsPilot
projects.summary: Investigate an incident and keep people in control of the response.
projects.problem: An automated remediation can become another incident if its scope and approval are unclear.
projects.approach: Create an evidence-grounded plan from repeatable telemetry, enforce action policies, and require decisions before catalogued local actions.

projects.title: Gatehouse
projects.summary: Make code-review decisions reproducible and inspectable.
projects.problem: A review gate needs consistent rules and traceable findings to be useful to developers.
projects.approach: Parse submitted diffs, normalize findings, evaluate severity and test policies, and retain recurring-risk evidence.

projects.title: Pathfinder
projects.summary: Take a service from a governed template to a working starter.
projects.problem: Teams repeat the same setup work while ownership and dependencies become scattered.
projects.approach: Render deterministic service archives with checksums, tests, and CI configuration, backed by a catalog and versioned templates.

projects.title: AgentShield Lab
projects.summary: Compare vulnerable and guarded application behavior side by side.
projects.problem: AI security claims are easier to assess when the inputs, policies, and resulting behavior are visible.
projects.approach: Run six threat scenarios in a confined synthetic sandbox, compare traces, and export the assessment.

projects.title: Quantum Ledger
projects.summary: Find cryptographic usage and make migration work reviewable.
projects.problem: Cryptographic migration starts with knowing what algorithms are actually in use and where.
projects.approach: Scan bounded source and configuration inputs, preserve finding evidence, and rank migration work with explicit observation provenance.

projects.title: EdgeForge
projects.summary: Validate, version, and roll back small execution rules.
projects.problem: A plugin platform needs artifact validation and safe lifecycle controls before it can trust an uploaded rule.
projects.approach: Validate real Wasm structure, quarantine versions, gate canaries, and enforce compare-and-set activation and rollback.

projects.title: RouteLab
projects.summary: Train a routing policy and see what happens when a link fails.
projects.problem: Routing experiments need repeatable conditions and fair baseline comparisons.
projects.approach: Simulate a directed network, train tabular Q-learning, compare deterministic baselines, and replay failures with experiment evidence.

projects.title: Capacity Pilot
projects.summary: Explore tomorrow's link saturation before buying more capacity.
projects.problem: Upgrade decisions need demand forecasts and a way to compare alternatives within a budget.
projects.approach: Fit explainable trends to telemetry, quantify uncertainty, rank actions, and save what-if scenarios for comparison.

projects.title: NeuroFlow
projects.summary: When does a router that learns from delay beat shortest paths?
projects.problem: Static shortest-path routing collapses once its busiest node saturates, while load-sensitive routing is known to oscillate.
projects.approach: A discrete-event simulator of single-server queues, verified against M/M/1 and M/D/1 theory, compares shortest-path, load-aware distance-vector, and Q-routing across load.

projects.title: ASP-1
projects.summary: A power-starved deep-space probe that decides for itself when to navigate and what to send home.
projects.problem: At 100 AU a probe wakes for two hours every 16.7 days. Each window must be split between navigation fixes and science, and the downlink cannot carry everything.
projects.approach: A two-year mission simulator: a statistically consistent 9-state Kalman filter decides when pulsar fixes are worth their cost, a bigram model arithmetic-codes routine telemetry and flags surprises, and an eigenaxis controller slews with reaction wheels.
highlights: Lossless, model-coded downlink that flags every anomaly
Kalman filter checked with NEES over 120 runs

projects.title: MIT OCW Smart Scraper
projects.summary: Turn an entire MIT OpenCourseWare course into one organized, searchable archive.
projects.problem: Course material is spread across dozens of pages, videos, captions, and PDFs that are tedious to collect.
projects.approach: Discovers courses (with a Selenium fallback for JavaScript pages), follows every section and video gallery, downloads within size limits, and merges everything into one PDF with a table of contents.
highlights: 1,110-page merged PDF from a live course

projects.title: Effekt website
projects.summary: A multilingual portfolio for bath, sauna, and pool work, introduced by interactive water.
projects.problem: A visual business needed a fast site in three languages whose long Azerbaijani words never break badly.
projects.approach: React and Three.js with a WebGL water introduction, responsive AVIF/WebP imagery, and syllable-based hyphenation for Azerbaijani and Russian headings.
